messages:
maria: quick async check — I finished onboarding `es-longcontext-smallq` to staging and ran the usual eval sweep. Found a tokenization mismatch on some Spanish quotes/punctuation that flips generation for a handful of prompt variants. gist: https://gist.example/abc123 (contains failing examples + eval summary)

 tj: thanks — can you paste one failing prompt+output here so I can repro locally?

 maria: sure, one example below:
```
PROMPT: "Resuma el siguiente texto: —El sistema funciona—, dijo el ingeniero."
MODEL OUT: "El sistema funciona, dijo el ingeniero."  <-- lost em-dash delimiters, affects downstream parsing
```
Also seeing BLEU down ~2% on spanish_summ short-context set.

 chris: pinging for a quick CR review: I opened PR #472 to add a small normalization step and a smoke test. @maria can you link the hotlist examples in the PR?

 olga: noticed the BLEU delta too. My hunch is kv-cache token boundary handling when sequence length > 1024 + quant rounding noise. I'll add a couple quick eval slices to the dashboard.

 maria: repro steps I used: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model es-longcontext-smallq --promptset spanish_summ --subset short --seed 42`

 tj: I'll take the kv-cache hypothesis. Running a debug run with verbose token boundaries now; will grep for punctuation token ids and compare across fp16 vs int8 runs.

 chris: if I'm adding the smoke test, I'll keep batch=1 and short promptset to keep infra cost low. ping me when staging model is stable and I'll land the PR. :thumbsup:

 maria: @tj when you run, please check normalization of "—" vs "-" vs "—" (there are mixed unicode dashes in the dataset). Also check tokenizer config `trim_unicode=true` in the tokenizers.yaml.

 eval-bot: CI smoke for PR #472 completed — staging smoke: PASSED, perf baseline within 0.5% of tokens/sec.

 olga: added 12 examples to the hotlist (dashboard: /evals/hotlists/674). @maria I left notes on which prompt variants flip.

 maria: thanks. Plan: queue a 10% canary rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT if no further regressions. I'll update the rollout page and notify infra. If anyone sees issues before then, drop them here and I'll pause the rollout.

 chris: noted. will review PR today and add the test.

 tj: I'll report back with the token id diffs in ~1h.
